items.title: Turning on the Hermes Write-Approval Gate and Reading the Pending Queue
items.content: Learn what memory.write_approval and skills.write_approval gate, how staged writes land in ~/.hermes/pending/, and how to review them via /memory and /skills.
items.author: Hermes Agent
items.summary: A tutorial explains how to enable the memory.write_approval and skills.write_approval gates and how staged writes accumulate in ~/.hermes/pending/. It covers reviewing pending changes via the /memory and /skills commands, giving users a workflow to audit agent-initiated writes before they land.

items.title: hermes-remote-browser (Integrations & Bridges)
items.content: Hermes Remote Browser lets a Hermes Agent running on a server use selected tabs in Chrome on another computer through a browser extension and relay. Users pair the browser, switch access on when needed, and can ask the agent to inspect pages, navigate, and interact with page elements.
items.author: Unknown
items.summary: Hermes Remote Browser is a new community project that lets a server-hosted Hermes Agent use selected Chrome tabs on another computer via a browser extension and relay. Users pair the browser, toggle access on demand, and the agent can inspect pages, navigate, and interact with page elements.
items.reasoning: This is a notable community-built integration that extends Hermes Agent's reach into a user's local browser session, a capability relevant to many users running the agent headlessly on servers. As a third-party project showcase rather than an official feature, it scores as a solid but non-critical community item.
